decision.title: EXP-OLLARMA-SWARM-002 inert-control calibration preregistration
decision.hypothesis_space: The PROMPT-OLLARMA-SWARM-001 T9b inert-control round0-to-round1 JSD of 0.0412 is either a reproducible cold-start/sampling artifact across inert prompt forms or evidence that the strict inert-control threshold/measurement protocol requires remediation before Phase 70 closeout.
decision.design_summary: Run five inert prompt forms under the same Phase 70 local-GPU swarm settings (qwen2.5-coder:7b, N=50, M=5, seed=42, temperature=0.0). Measure per-prompt round-over-round JSD, max JSD, and cold-start round0-to-round1 versus later-round steady-state behavior. Allocation is limited to PROMPT creation for EXP-OLLARMA-SWARM-002; execution remains a later SWE action.

artifact_maturity.evidence: Committed T9b acceptance verdict records PARTIAL outcome and inert-control max round-over-round JSD 0.04120259398127841.
EXP-OLLARMA-SWARM-001 note records T9b RUN-COMPLETE, PARTIAL verdict, and closeout blocked status.
Remediation plan defines EXP-OLLARMA-SWARM-002 goal, method, measures, and success criteria.

claim_ceiling.pass_language: EXP-002 may support a bounded calibration claim about whether the T9b inert-control wobble reproduces across inert prompt forms under the same local-GPU swarm settings.
claim_ceiling.fail_language: EXP-002 may show that the inert-control wobble is not reproducible under the tested inert prompt variants; it does not by itself validate Phase 70 closeout.
claim_ceiling.pass_does_not_prove_language: A PASS does not prove the predictive persona swarm is generally valid, does not close T11/T12, and does not authorize threshold changes without EXP-003/004 or PI disposition.
